source_transcription_notes: Image 3 has #493126 and #78533B; Image 5 instead has #493027 and #76503B. Preserve both distinct ramps.
Image 9 Stop 4 is #235347 (not #235347 with an extra digit); forest jump from Stop 4 to Stop 5 is unusually large.
Image 11/13 final stop is #CCD0CF (zero in D0), not #CCDOCF.
Hex labels are the source of truth; photographed/processed pixel colors include gradients, shadows and compression.

method.classification: Classified with full precision, displayed to two decimals. AAA >=7, AA >=4.5, large/UI >=3, fail <3. Large text >=24 CSS px regular or >=18.67 CSS px bold. UI threshold applies to identifying information, not every decorative divider.
method.limitation: Numbers apply to solid supplied HEX values, not screenshot pixels with lighting/gradient overlays.

palettes.name: Olive & Linen
notes: The original S3 does not support both normal primary and secondary text in dark mode; this recipe deliberately reuses S2 for raised surfaces. All exported role pairs pass.

Use a focus outline with an offset exposing canvas/surface; verify against every adjacent color, especially a primary button.
Dark primaryPressed intentionally retains its fill; add inset/position feedback or derive and recheck a darker tint instead of using unchecked Stop 4.
